in_marathi.name: Jhanakavi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jhanakavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jhanakavi is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'jhanana' which means 'to delight'. The name is often used for girls in Hindu tradition, symbolizing joy, happiness, and delight.
